```yaml
name: Remove Experimental Decorators

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 1 * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  remove-experimental-decorators:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Run remove_experimental_decorators.py
        id: run_script
        run: |
          python dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py
          SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=$?
          if [ $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::warning::Script failed with exit code $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE"
            exit $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE
          fi

      - name: Check for changes
        id: git_status
        run: |
          git status --porcelain
          if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "no_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "no_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create PR
        if: steps.git_status.outputs.no_changes == 'false'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S")
          BRANCH_NAME="automated/remove-experimental-decorators-${TIMESTAMP}"
          
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          
          git checkout -b "${BRANCH_NAME}"
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: remove experimental decorators"
          git push origin "${BRANCH_NAME}"
          
          cat > /tmp/pr_body.txt << 'EOF'
          ## Automated Removal of Experimental Decorators
          
          This PR was automatically generated by the monthly workflow to remove
          experimental decorators from the codebase.
          
          ### Changes
          - Removed `@experimental` decorators from functions/classes
          - Updated docstrings if necessary
          
          ### Review
          Please review the changes to ensure no functionality was broken.
          EOF
          
          gh pr create \
            --title "chore: remove experimental decorators" \
            --body-file /tmp/pr_body.txt \
            --label "automated" \
            --head "${BRANCH_NAME}" \
            --base main
```
